    <h2>{`Overview`}</h2>
    <p>{`This guide demonstrates patterns for automatically populating default values when users create new records in Maximo Mobile applications. These techniques ensure data consistency, reduce user input errors, and enforce business rules at the point of record creation.`}</p>
    <p><strong parentName="p">{`Use Cases:`}</strong></p>
    <ul>
      <li parentName="ul">{`Standardize field values across record creation based on organizational policies`}</li>
      <li parentName="ul">{`Pre-populate records with values inherited from parent records`}</li>
      <li parentName="ul">{`Reduce data entry time and errors by providing sensible defaults for required fields`}</li>
      <li parentName="ul">{`Enforce business rules and data validation at creation time`}</li>
    </ul>
    <p><strong parentName="p">{`Prerequisites:`}</strong></p>
    <ul>
      <li parentName="ul">{`Basic understanding of Maximo Mobile datasources and schemas`}</li>

    <h2>{`Implementation`}</h2>
    <h3>{`Step 1: Define configuration constants`}</h3>
    <p>{`Create constants to store default values rather than hardcoding them throughout your code. This centralized approach improves maintainability and makes configuration changes easier.`}</p>
    <p><strong parentName="p">{`JavaScript Implementation:`}</strong></p>
    <pre><code parentName="pre" {...{
        "className": "language-js"
      }}>{`/**
 * Default values for record creation
 * Centralize configuration for easy maintenance and updates
 */
const DEFAULT_FIELD_ONE = 'VALUE_A'; // Description of what this represents
const DEFAULT_FIELD_TWO = 1; // Description of what this represents
`}</code></pre>
    <p><strong parentName="p">{`Key Takeaways:`}</strong></p>
    <ul>
      <li parentName="ul"><strong parentName="li">{`Centralization:`}</strong>{` Keep all default values in one location for easy updates`}</li>
      <li parentName="ul"><strong parentName="li">{`Documentation:`}</strong>{` Add comments explaining the meaning of coded values`}</li>
      <li parentName="ul"><strong parentName="li">{`Naming:`}</strong>{` Use descriptive constant names that clearly indicate their purpose`}</li>
      <li parentName="ul"><strong parentName="li">{`Flexibility:`}</strong>{` Consider making these configurable through app settings for different environments`}</li>
    </ul>

Constants are defined and can be referenced throughout the controller for consistent default value application.`}</p>
    <h3>{`Step 2: Choose the most appropriate alternative from easiest to hardest`}</h3>

    <h3>{`Approach 1: Configure datasource schema with default values`}</h3>
    <p>{`Set default values directly in the datasource schema for new record creation. This declarative approach applies automatically when new records are added to the datasource.`}</p>
    <p><strong parentName="p">{`XML Configuration:`}</strong></p>
    <pre><code parentName="pre" {...{
        "className": "language-xml"
      }}>{`<!-- Datasource schema with default values -->
<maximo-datasource id="dsCreateRecord" object-structure="MXAPI[OBJECTNAME]">
  <schema>
    <!-- Field with default value -->
    <attribute name="fieldOne" id="attr_001" default-value="VALUE_A"/>
    
    <!-- Another field with default value -->
    <attribute name="fieldTwo" id="attr_002" default-value="1"/>
    
    <!-- Add other required attributes -->
  </schema>
</maximo-datasource>
`}</code></pre>
    <p><strong parentName="p">{`Key Takeaways:`}</strong></p>
    <ul>
      <li parentName="ul"><strong parentName="li">{`Declarative Approach:`}</strong>{` Schema defaults are the simplest method for static values`}</li>
      <li parentName="ul"><strong parentName="li">{`Automatic Application:`}</strong>{` Defaults apply to all new record creation scenarios using this datasource`}</li>
      <li parentName="ul"><strong parentName="li">{`Early Initialization:`}</strong>{` Schema defaults are applied before any programmatic logic runs`}</li>
      <li parentName="ul"><strong parentName="li">{`Type Awareness:`}</strong>{` Default values should match the attribute’s data type`}</li>
      <li parentName="ul"><strong parentName="li">{`Scope:`}</strong>{` This method works universally across the application for the datasource`}</li>
    </ul>
    <p><strong parentName="p">{`Expected Result:`}</strong>{`
When a new record is created through this datasource, the specified fields are automatically initialized with the configured default values.`}</p>
    <h3>{`Approach 2: Set defaults programmatically using onAddNewRecord`}</h3>
    <p>{`For scenarios requiring conditional logic or dynamic defaults, implement the `}<inlineCode parentName="p">{`onAddNewRecord`}</inlineCode>{` event handler in your datasource controller.`}</p>
    <p><strong parentName="p">{`JavaScript Implementation:`}</strong></p>
    <pre><code parentName="pre" {...{
        "className": "language-js"
      }}>{`/**
 * Add new record handler
 * Sets default values dynamically when creating new records
 * @param {Object} params - Event parameters
 * @param {Datasource} params.datasource - The datasource instance
 * @param {Object} params.item - The new record item
 */
onAddNewRecord({datasource, item}) {
  const TAG = 'SetDefaultValues';
  
  // Only apply defaults for the specific datasource
  if (datasource?.name === 'dsCreateRecord' && datasource?.schema) {
    this.app.log.d(TAG, 'Setting default values for new record');
    
    // Set default values through schema properties
    // This approach ensures compatibility with schema validation
    datasource.schema.properties.fieldOne.defaultValue = DEFAULT_FIELD_ONE;
    datasource.schema.properties.fieldTwo.defaultValue = DEFAULT_FIELD_TWO;
    
    this.app.log.d(TAG, 'Default values configured in schema');
  }
}
`}</code></pre>
    <p><strong parentName="p">{`Key Takeaways:`}</strong></p>
    <ul>
      <li parentName="ul"><strong parentName="li">{`Dynamic Defaults:`}</strong>{` Use this approach when defaults need to be calculated or depend on application state`}</li>
      <li parentName="ul"><strong parentName="li">{`Schema Properties:`}</strong>{` Modify `}<inlineCode parentName="li">{`schema.properties[].defaultValue`}</inlineCode>{` to ensure values are treated as schema defaults`}</li>
      <li parentName="ul"><strong parentName="li">{`Event Timing:`}</strong>{` This method runs before the record is displayed to the user`}</li>
      <li parentName="ul"><strong parentName="li">{`Datasource Identification:`}</strong>{` Check datasource name to apply defaults only where intended`}</li>
      <li parentName="ul"><strong parentName="li">{`Avoid Direct Assignment:`}</strong>{` Don’t set values directly on the `}<inlineCode parentName="li">{`item`}</inlineCode>{` object to prevent conflicts with schema validation`}</li>

<attribute name="worktype" id="y6nm_" default-value="CM"/>
